title: Field
description: A continuous quantity over space and time: a grid on a frame, or a series with one value for the whole planet at each time. Its arrays live outside git. A derived field is declared, never stored.

refines.description: For a series: the series of the same quantity that this one is finer than, over part of its span. Where both have a value, the panel shows this one

oneOf.description: A series: one value for the whole planet at each time
Rows of a dataset at places, drawn over the globe for the times they hold

file.description: The dataset's file, where it has several

as.description: What the data is read as, where it is not elevation

places.description: For borders: the dataset of places that goes with them

prop.description: A series of the world's own measurements: the property whose claims give its values, each at its record's date. `from` then names the work that frames them

sheet.description: For a workbook: the sheet the series is on

first_row.description: For a workbook: the first row of data

columns.description: For a series read from a table: the columns of its time, its value and the band around it; names in a text table, letters in a workbook

time_to.description: The other end of the interval each row covers: a row is plotted at its middle

time_unit.description: What the time column counts: Ma, ka or years before 1950, ka before 2000, or calendar years

band.description: What the lo–hi band is, e.g. the 5th–95th percentiles of an ensemble

scenarios.description: For grids with several readings of the same thing: the first is the default picture's, and an alternative may draw another

variable.description: The variable of the dataset's file that holds it

span.description: Where it differs in kind from the first: elsewhere the first is drawn

projection.description: After its youngest snapshot, the field holds that snapshot as a projection until `until`

params.description: The rule's parameters, or for a grid read by the build what it needs besides its data

source.description: Where the rule or those parameters come from

uncertainty.description: What a click says of how far to trust a value of it, where a grid has no error bars
